column1: # Gene-signature modules for Stage-5 continuum-vs-hybrid scoring (Phase 2).
# Each module is scored per cell with scanpy sc.tl.score_genes on the typed cohort.
# The four Neftel GBM malignant states (AC/MES/OPC/NPC-like) sit on two axes: AC<->MES and
# OPC<->NPC. A cell co-elevating states WITHIN an axis is a continuum (gradient along one arm);
# a cell co-elevating states ACROSS axes (AC/MES x OPC/NPC) beyond chance is a genuine two-state
# HYBRID (insitucnv_hybrid_continuum.py tests this per state-pair). Cycling is a proliferation
# module. Gene lists are canonical Neftel-like signatures intersected with the ~6k CosMx panel.
